title: Cobbled Up
description: A 1.21 cobblemon focused modpack with some extra content, tech, and  QOL mods.
body:
## Cobbled Up Info
This modpack is mainly focused around cobblemon, but it has some extra content added to the vanilla minecraft gameplay loop including some adventure and exploration mods, as well as Applied Energistics 2 to help with inventory clutter. No power generating mods are included, so you have to be creative to sustain larger AE2 setups using vanilla farms and the vibration chamber as a burner fuel source.

Although this pack should be fairly well optimized, cobblemon is pretty content heavy so clients require decent hardware and at least 4 GB of ram (preferably more). BSL shaders are installed but are toggled off by default.

Servers are recommended to use at least 4 GB of ram, but if you are hosting for more than 4 players then you might want more.

- Cobblemon Capture XP
- Cobblemon:Mega Showdown
- Cobblenav
- Cobbreeding
